items.title: Show HN: Stratosync – on-demand cloud sync for Linux with FUSE and rclone (BETA)
items.contentSnippet:
I came across Stratosync recently and thought it was worth sharing here. I’m not affiliated with the project.
It seems to be trying to fill a gap that Linux still has: a decent “files on demand” style cloud sync client, where the filesystem is mounted normally but file contents are only downloaded when needed instead of mirroring everything locally. One can also pin files to keep them in sync.

items.title: Show HN: Kaden – Linux Terminal where Ctrl+C copies
items.contentSnippet:
I made Kaden because every other Linux terminal lacks proper text selection.
Kaden supports Ctrl-C, A, V for copying, selecting and pasting, no more awkward three button hotkeys or fiddling with your mouse to do basic copy pasting.
- Contextual copy/kill bindings to Ctrl-C.
- Feature rich: Inline suggestion, filter output, Themes and custom font, open URLs or files with Ctrl-Click.

items.title: Show HN: Slock – A one-bit messenger inside your capslock key
items.contentSnippet:
Two computers, one bit.
Hi — I built slock, a small macOS menu bar app that connects two people through their capslock lights.
Hold capslock on your Mac, and the other person’s capslock light turns on. Let go, and it turns off.
That’s all. A tiny way to interact someone without opening a chat window. Invent a blink language, try Morse code, or just bother someone who agreed to install this with you.
If you both opt in, the same key also becomes a push-to-talk walkie-talkie.

items.title: Show HN: Say Toucan – my feedback board 3x'd its price, so I built my own
items.contentSnippet:
My user feedback board provider increased its price from $15 to $25 to $50/mo, so I built a ~free alternative that does just the few things I need: make a feature request, vote on feature requests from others.
There's a paid tier at $2/mo, and I only need ~1% of users to opt-in to pay to offset server costs.
Of course, you can request features on Say Toucan using Say Toucan: https://saytoucan.com/b/say-toucan
(The name is so dumb and I'm so thrilled with myself. Say Toucan do it!)
